programs.title: Tim
programs.desc: A 20-year-old guy with some learning difficulties has a job as a laborer, but people take advantage of his innocence. A kind 40-year-old American woman hires him and they become good friends. However, the townspeople and his family view her as someone with bad intentions.

programs.title: Sherlock Holmes: Incident At Victoria Falls Part One
programs.desc: King Edward asks Sherlock Holmes to perform one more task before his retirement: to safeguard the Star of Africa on a trip to Cape Town. Soon the fabled jewel is stolen and several people end up being murdered.

programs.title: Sherlock Holmes: Incident At Victoria Falls Part Two
programs.desc: King Edward asks Sherlock Holmes to perform one more task before his retirement: to safeguard the Star of Africa on a trip to Cape Town. Soon the fabled jewel is stolen and several people end up being murdered.

programs.title: Here Kills the Bride
programs.desc: Carlos' sister finds out that he is getting married in a week to Grace, a girl he just met in a strip club. His sister investigates and gets pulled into a whirlwind of events, putting her own life at risk.

programs.title: Baby Obsession
programs.desc: Anna Gray is pregnant and ready to start a family with her loving husband Jon. But she has no idea that Rachel, the mother of a baby who died from SIDS when Anna babysat her years ago, has been waiting for this day, determined to take back what Anna 'took from me'.

programs.title: Mazes and Monsters
